project_type: Next.js 16 App Router, static export (output: 'export'), deployed to Cloudflare Workers via wrangler
build_system: Next.js 16.4.0 with `output: 'export'` and `trailingSlash: true`. Static HTML output — NO server actions, NO API routes available in the exported pages. After next build, a separate `node scripts/build-worker.mjs` step bundles the Cloudflare Worker.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run typecheck` — must pass with 0 errors. 2. Run `npm run build` — must complete with no errors. Build output goes to `out/` directory.
snapshot_or_generated_files: `.next/` and `out/` directories are generated by `npm run build`. `node scripts/build-worker.mjs` produces the worker bundle. These are not committed.
environment_constraints: Static export means NO server actions or API routes in page files. All interactive logic must be client components with 'use client'. Contact form must use mailto: action (GET method), NOT a server action. The worker in worker/index.ts handles /api/orders separately via Cloudflare, not Next.js routing.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns: Server Components for static content pages, 'use client' only when hooks are needed.
key_patterns: 1. CSS variables: --green:#173f30, --lime:#d4ec9c, --ink:#20392d, --muted:#778077, --line:#e3e7df, --paper:#fafbf8. 2. Font: IBM Plex Sans Arabic from Google Fonts (already imported in globals.css). 3. RTL: set at html level in layout.tsx (lang='ar' dir='rtl') — all pages inherit this. 4. Brand icon pattern: `` with lucide-react Leaf icon. 5. .wrap class: `width:min(1240px,calc(100% - 96px));margin-inline:auto` for centered content. 6. page.tsx is 'use client' (full single-page app). New policy pages are Server Components. 7. lucide-react icons available (Leaf, etc.). 8. Price component: currently shows SAR bold/large first, EGP smaller second — must swap to EGP first. 9. Benefits section text 'أسعار واضحة بعملتين · بالريال السعودي والجنيه المصري' must change to 'أسعار واضحة بالجنيه المصري'. 10. Checkout consent label must gain links to /terms and /privacy.
relevant_files: app/page.tsx — main client component to modify (Price component, footer, nav, checkout consent)
app/layout.tsx — update metadata description; html/body wrapper (RTL already set)
app/globals.css — add footer and policy-page CSS
app/products.ts — EXCHANGE_RATE=13.95, product prices in SAR, number() formatter
app/page-layout.tsx — NEW shared layout component for policy pages
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router root (page.tsx, layout.tsx, globals.css, products.ts). public/ — static assets (farm.jpg, fertilizer.png, *.webp, favicon.svg). worker/ — Cloudflare Worker (index.ts). scripts/ — build scripts. No test directory.
